title: 2020-21 Panini Prizm - Pink Ice Prizm #77 Kentavious Caldwell-Pope Lakers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2020-21 Panini Prizm trading card features Kentavious Caldwell-Pope from the Los Angeles Lakers in his National Basketball Association (NBA) uniform. The card is from the Pink Ice parallel/variety set and has a print run of 175. It is also serial numbered and part of the base set.

This sports trading card is manufactured by Panini and is a great addition to any NBA or sports trading card collection. Whether you're a Lakers fan, a basketball enthusiast, or a collector of parallel/variety cards, this Pink Ice Prizm trading card is a must-have. Get your hands on this card today and enjoy the excitement of collecting!
